verdict.rationale: The Search API docs list "content extraction for developers" as a feature, and the Agent API offers a built-in URL fetch tool whose results are returned inline. That is Perplexity's own capability for getting page content beyond ranked results. However, no evidence says full page text or markdown is returned to the developer, and the CLI is described as returning "query-relevant page snippets." Missing for 10: explicit documentation of full-text or markdown output fields in search results, details of the content-extraction parameters, and any hands-on or independent confirmation that full page content is returned.
